body:
The Amiga opening audit identified unsupported language-wide speed, numeric-safety and OS-trade claims. This records the bounded corrections, primary-source locators, exact before/after claims, source identities and three retained AmiBlitz probes. It also explains the misplaced disk-settling wait corrected in code198x/code-samples#99.

Validation: production build passes (2,459 pages); content checks pass; ten generated routes have linked header styles and resolving Amiga links. Exact capture typing and probe/source checks pass; the old wait order is rejected. All seven evidence hashes pass.

Fresh runtime and desktop/phone visual checks are **not performed**: computer use reports “Sky Computer Use native pipe startup failed”, with no available apps or browsers. The report also retains the partial archive-extraction failure. No benchmark, whole-course compatibility or learner-effectiveness result is claimed. Keep draft until remaining review or explicit owner acceptance.

Part of code198x/website#767 and stevehill1981/198x#116. The website draft will link here; merge the sample correction before the website.
title: Record evidence for the Amiga opening claims corrections
